user.title: Connect to Tautulli
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Tautulli server. Find the API key in **Tautulli → Settings → Web Interface**.

data_description.server_name: Leave blank to use the Plex server name reported by Tautulli.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only when Tautulli uses a trusted private network and a self-signed certificate.

features.title: Choose features
features.description: Select the optional features you want to configure. Only the relevant setup pages will be shown.

data_description.advanced_attributes: Adds extra media, player and stream details to active-stream entities.
data_description.plex_enabled: Uses a Plex token to add metadata such as credits markers. Tautulli-only features work without it.

location.title: Location and privacy
location.description: Choose how public stream IP addresses are resolved. Detailed location data is disabled by default.

data_description.geo_provider: Tautulli uses its local GeoLite2 database. ip-api.com sends public IP addresses to an external service.
data_description.expose_detailed_location: Adds public IP address, postal code and coordinates to Home Assistant attributes and recorder history.

statistics.title: Watch-history statistics
statistics.description: Choose the reporting period and how often statistics are refreshed.

data_description.statistics_period: Rolling uses a fixed number of recent days. Calendar month begins on day 1. Custom monthly cycle begins on your selected day.
data_description.statistics_interval: A longer interval reduces Tautulli API, database and Home Assistant recorder load.

statistics_range.title: Statistics period details
statistics_range.description: Configure the selected reporting period. No Tautulli history is deleted when a new period begins.

data_description.statistics_cycle_day: Choose 1 to 31. Shorter months use their final day.

plex.title: Connect to Plex
plex.description: Enter a Plex token and the URL that Home Assistant can use to reach Plex. The connection and token will be tested before they are saved.

data_description.plex_base_url: Usually http://PLEX-SERVER-IP:32400. The value reported by Tautulli is provided when available.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Tautulli Active Streams
reauth_confirm.description: Tautulli rejected the saved API key. Enter a replacement key for this server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tautulli connection
reconfigure.description: Update the server name or network connection. API-key changes are handled by the separate reauthentication flow.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Tautulli. Check the URL, network connection and SSL setting.
error.cannot_connect_plex: Unable to connect to Plex. Check the Plex URL and network connection.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm that you want to remove the saved Plex credentials.
error.invalid_api_key_reauth: Tautulli rejected the saved API key. Complete the reauthentication flow before reconfiguring the connection.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without a query string or sign-in details.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.wrong_server: The supplied connection belongs to a different Plex server. Add it as a separate integration instead.

init.title: Tautulli Active Streams options
init.description: Choose the area you want to configure.

general.title: General options
general.description: Configure active-stream polling and entity attributes. Changes are applied automatically.

statistics.title: Watch-history statistics
statistics.description: Enable or disable per-user watch-history statistics.

statistics_details.title: Statistics settings
statistics_details.description: Choose the reporting period and refresh interval.

data_description.statistics_period: Rolling uses a fixed number of recent days. Calendar month begins on day 1. Custom monthly cycle begins on your selected day.
data_description.statistics_interval: A longer interval reduces Tautulli API, database and Home Assistant recorder load.

statistics_range.title: Statistics period details
statistics_range.description: Configure the selected reporting period. No Tautulli history is deleted when a new period begins.

data_description.statistics_cycle_day: Choose 1 to 31. Shorter months use their final day.

privacy.title: Location and privacy
privacy.description: Enable or disable geolocation for public stream IP addresses.

privacy_details.title: Geolocation settings
privacy_details.description: Detailed location data is disabled by default.

data_description.geo_provider: Tautulli uses its local GeoLite2 database. ip-api.com sends public IP addresses to an external service.
data_description.expose_detailed_location: Adds public IP address, postal code and coordinates to Home Assistant attributes and recorder history.

plex.title: Plex metadata enrichment
plex.description: Plex access is optional and is only used for additional metadata such as credits markers.

plex_details.title: Plex connection
plex_details.description: Update the Plex connection. Leave the token blank to keep the saved token. The connection will be tested before saving.

confirm_disable_plex.title: Disable Plex enrichment?
confirm_disable_plex.description: Disabling Plex enrichment permanently removes the saved Plex token and URL. Tautulli active streams and statistics will continue to work.

error.cannot_connect_plex: Unable to connect to Plex. Check the Plex URL and network connection.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm that you want to remove the saved Plex credentials.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without a query string or sign-in details.
